intro: Five systems and initiatives that show the kind of problem I solve: domain complexity, incremental evolution, and technical decisions with an effect on institutional processes.

items.title: GURI
items.summary: The ERP that administers the university administrative resources, with over 50 integrated modules. I worked as requirements analyst, module manager, developer, documenter, and code and documentation reviewer.

items.title: SisPPA
items.summary: Web system to manage, validate and score academic output, built on MVC and spreadsheet reverse engineering. Published at WTICIFES 2026.

items.title: App Unipampa
items.summary: The university official app, with academic services and institutional information. Published for Android and iOS.

items.title: MESPro
items.kind: Software Engineering Methodology · Proof of Concept
items.summary: A proposed estimation and development method, with explicit hypotheses, estimation criteria and a calibration mechanism. It is under experimentation; the matching tool is a proof of concept.

items.title: Petrux
items.summary: An experiment in writing the software engineering process as code: thirteen phases, each with an owner, inputs, outputs and a stop criterion, built on specialized agents with mandatory human validation. Experimental.
